sar.narrative: On on 2016-12-28, card C08299-K1 belonging to customer C08299 was utilized in 1 unauthorized transaction(s) (3581141) totaling $30.02 USD. The flagged activity conforms to card not present fraud methodology. Forensic analysis identified shared device infrastructure (DeviceProfile-HHG-009 | Android 7.0 | Chrome) linking this cardholder to coordinated activity. Additional compromised card accounts identified in the syndicate cluster include C08299-K2. The cardholder was contacted via customer verification protocols and confirmed that they did not initiate or authorize these charges. Under bank fraud policy Policy R2/R6, the card has been blocked and flagged for law enforcement reporting due to confirmed illicit activity.

stop_reason: Customer verification response settled the question and policy actions selected.
